title: os verify still writes test rows through a declared managed secondary datasource, which can point at a real database
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ① product defect · Source: fleet · out-of-scope finding of PR #35509 (card #35255), named in os-dev-report 7011226452; L1 REWORK record 7011371936 ruled a card owed (p2, area:build), with the generic-cascade wording nit folded in as a line item. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: area:build · Bug · Impeded · uncommon (an app that routes objects to a declared managed datasource bound to a real database) · read from the code, reach not measured → p2.

## Business reason

A developer runs `os verify` expecting its test data to stay in verify's own in-memory store. If the app routes an object to a declared datasource with `schemaMode: 'managed'` (or none) and that datasource points at a real database, verify's CRUD, reference-shape, delete-behaviour and unique-scope rows are written into that database. Card #35255 asked that "the CRUD phase writes only to the ephemeral stack"; the shape ruled for it (PR #35509) covers objects on external datasources only, so this half remains.

## What happens

`bootStack` connects every datasource the app declares (ADR-0062 D2 connects a datasource an object binds to). After PR #35509, `deriveCrudCases` (`packages/verify/src/derive.ts`) blocks an object on an external datasource (an `external` block, or a declared `schemaMode` other than `managed`), but an object bound to a declared managed datasource is not blocked, so every write family built from the CRUD case writes through that datasource, as under `os dev`.

## Expected

During `os verify`, no write verify itself derives reaches a datasource the app declares: either such objects are redirected to the ephemeral store, or they are left out and named in the report the way PR #35509 names external ones. The verify README and the `harness.ts` header then say so.

## Done when

- A verify test with a recording driver behind a declared managed secondary datasource runs the write families and records zero writes from verify, with a control showing a REST create still reaches the driver.
- Line item (wording): a managed object that requires a reference to a withheld object is reported with the generic cascade sentence "required relational target X is not synthesizable"; the report says the target was withheld on purpose and names why.

Who acts: the area that owns `packages/verify` (area:build, CLI/verify area).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open verify managed datasource write` → only #35255 (the parent card, shape ruled to external datasources); also tried the dev's words "os verify secondary datasource writes", "datasource D2 auto-connect verify": none covers it.
